data.label: Order Response Governed Record
data.description: An order response record. The governed record: the data cluster, the PROV activity and agent, the order received as the PROV entity the activity used, and the audit event from the ProvGov library by identifier. Members: Order Response; prov-activity (Provgov); prov-agent (Provgov); prov-entity (Provgov); audit-event (Provgov).

items.label: Audit Event
items.description: A logged access or custody event as data: what was done, by whom, on what, with what outcome and for what purpose. The audit-only case of sdc5 issue 002; state-changing operations are workflow transitions.

items.label: Audit Agent Reference
items.description: The acting agent (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.who). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Entity Reference
items.description: The entity the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.entity.what). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Event Identifier
items.description: The identifier of the audit event.

items.label: Data Subject Reference
items.description: The data subject or patient the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.patient; SDC DM.subject). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The party on whose behalf the agent acted (FHIR agent.onBehalfOf; prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: System Identifier
items.description: The system that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.source.observer; SDC AuditType.system-id).

items.label: System Location Name
items.description: The site or facility that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.location; prov:atLocation).

items.label: Audit Event Action
items.description: The operation performed in a logged access event (FHIR AuditEvent.action). Read and Execute change no state and are audit facts, not workflow moves.

items.label: Audit Event Outcome
items.description: The result of an audited event (FHIR AuditEvent.outcome).

items.label: Confidentiality
items.description: The level of protection the information requires (HL7 v3 Confidentiality). At assembly the value populates a component's act tag.

items.label: Provenance Agent Type
items.description: The functional role of an agent in an activity (FHIR Provenance.agent.type).

items.label: Purpose of Use
items.description: Why the information was used (HL7 v3 ActReason purpose of use). Activity context, not an access-control tag.

items.label: Audit Recorded At
items.description: When the audit event was recorded (FHIR AuditEvent.recorded).

items.label: Order Response
items.description: The seller's answer to a purchase order as a governed record: the document header with the answer to the order as a whole, the order it answers and the documents it refers to, the contract, the parties by role in one shape, the delivery and its terms, the payment means and terms, allowances and charges, the transaction conditions, the tax total, the legal monetary total, and the lines each with their answer. A conformant UBL OrderResponse is a projection of this record. Members: Order Response Document; Order Reference; Order Document Reference; Order Change Document Reference; Originator Document Reference; Additional Document Reference; Contract; Seller Supplier Party; Buyer Customer Party; Originator Customer Party; Accounting Supplier Party; Accounting Customer Party; Delivery; Delivery Terms; Payment Means Instruction; Payment Terms; Allowance Charge; Transaction Conditions; Tax Total; Legal Monetary Total; Order Response Lines.

items.label: Accounting Customer Party
items.description: The party the invoice for the order is to be sent to, when it is not the buyer. Members: Customer Party.

items.label: Customer Party
items.description: A party in the customer role: the account identifiers each side assigned, and the party itself. Members: Customer Assigned Account ID; Supplier Assigned Account ID; Party.

items.label: Customer Assigned Account ID
items.description: The identifier of the customer's account as the customer itself assigned it; on a supplier party, the identifier of the supplier as the customer assigned it.

items.label: Supplier Assigned Account ID
items.description: The identifier of the customer's account as the supplier assigned it.

items.label: Party
items.description: An organization fulfilling a role in the business process, one shape whatever the role: its endpoint, its identifiers with their schemes, its name and its postal address from the Default library (the same components a NIEM person's organization and a FHIR organization compose), its legal entity, and its contact. Members: Endpoint ID; Party Identification; organization-name (Default); us-address (Default); international-address (Default); Party Legal Entity; Party Contact.

items.label: Endpoint ID
items.description: The identifier of the party's endpoint on the network the documents travel over, commonly a Global Location Number.

items.label: Organization Name
items.description: The legal or registered name of an organization.

items.label: International Address
items.description: A mailing address in any country: street lines, city, region, postal code, country and use.

items.label: Address (Line 1)
items.description: The first line of a street address: street number and name, or a post office box.

items.label: Address (Line 2)
items.description: The second line of a street address: apartment, suite, unit, building or floor, when the first line does not carry it.

items.label: City Name
items.description: The name of the city, town or village in an address.

items.label: Postal Code
items.description: The postal code of an address in any country, with no format constraint. Use US ZIP Code or Canada Postal Code where the format is known.

items.label: Region Name
items.description: The name of the state, province or other administrative region in an address, written out rather than coded.

items.label: Address Use
items.description: The purpose of an address.

items.label: Country Code ISO 3166
items.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of a country or territory: the complete list of 249 officially assigned codes. Each value is defined by its Wikidata entity.

items.label: Party Contact
items.description: The contact at a party: its name, title and department, and the Default library's contact point (telephone, fax, email, website). Members: Contact Name; Contact Job Title; Contact Department; contact-point (Default).

items.label: Contact Department
items.description: The department the contact works in.

items.label: Contact Job Title
items.description: The job title or function of the contact.

items.label: Contact Name
items.description: The name of the contact at the party, a functional name (a department, a desk) in preference to a personal one.

items.label: Contact Point
items.description: Ways to reach a person or organization: phone, fax, email, website, and the method and use of the contact.

items.label: Website URL
items.description: The URL of a web page or online resource, such as an organization's website or a person's profile page.

items.label: Email Address
items.description: An email address. The pattern requires a local part, an at sign and a domain with a dot; RFC 5321 limits the whole address to 254 characters.

items.label: Fax Number
items.description: A facsimile telephone number, optionally starting with a plus sign and country code, with digits, spaces, hyphens and parentheses allowed.

items.label: Phone Number
items.description: A telephone number, optionally starting with a plus sign and country code, with digits, spaces, hyphens and parentheses allowed.

items.label: Contact Method
items.description: The communication channel of a contact point.

items.label: Contact Use
items.description: The purpose of a contact point.

items.label: Party Identification
items.description: One identifier of a party: the scheme it belongs to and the value in it. Members: Party Identification Scheme; Party Identification Value.

items.label: Party Identification Value
items.description: The identifier of the party, in the scheme the record names.

items.label: Party Identification Scheme
items.description: The identification system a party's identifier belongs to: a GS1 Global Location Number, a DUNS number, a tax identifier, a company registration number, an identifier the buyer assigned, an identifier the seller assigned, or one the parties agreed between themselves. A GLN is GS1's and a buyer-assigned number is the buyer's; the record says which.

items.label: Party Legal Entity
items.description: The party as a legal entity: its registered name and its company registration identifier. Members: Registration Name; Company ID.

items.label: Company ID
items.description: The identifier of the party in a company registration scheme.

items.label: Registration Name
items.description: The name of the party as registered with the relevant legal authority.

items.label: US Address
items.description: A United States mailing address: street lines, city, state, ZIP code, country and use.

items.label: US ZIP Code
items.description: A United States ZIP Code in five-digit or ZIP+4 form, for example 12345 or 12345-6789.

items.label: US State Code
items.description: The two-letter USPS abbreviation of a US state, the District of Columbia or a US territory. The definition of each value is its ISO 3166-2:US entry.

items.label: Accounting Supplier Party
items.description: The party that issues the invoice for the order, when it is not the seller. Members: Supplier Party.

items.label: Supplier Party
items.description: A party in the supplier role: the identifier the customer assigned it, and the party itself. Members: Customer Assigned Account ID; Party.

items.label: Additional Document Reference
items.description: Another document associated with the order. Members: Document Reference.

items.label: Document Reference
items.description: A reference to another document: its identifier, its issue date, what kind of document it is, and a description. Members: Document Reference ID; Document Reference Issue Date; Document Type; Document Description.

items.label: Document Description
items.description: Free text describing the referenced document for a reader.

items.label: Document Reference ID
items.description: The identifier of the referenced document.

items.label: Document Type
items.description: What kind of document is referenced: a quotation, a contract, a catalogue, the originator's document, an earlier order, or another document.

items.label: Document Reference Issue Date
items.description: The date the referenced document was issued, as its sender assigned it.

items.label: Allowance Charge
items.description: A charge added to, or an allowance deducted from, an amount: which of the two, why, and how much. Members: Charge Indicator; Allowance Charge Reason; Allowance Charge Reason Text; Multiplier Factor; Allowance Charge Amount; Base Amount.

items.label: Charge Indicator
items.description: Whether this is a charge added to the amount (true) or an allowance deducted from it (false).

items.label: Allowance Charge Reason Text
items.description: The reason for the allowance or charge, as text.

items.label: Allowance Charge Reason
items.description: The reason for the allowance or charge, from the UN/ECE allowance and charge reason list UBL carries as its default: the name of each reason, defined by the list entry.

enumerations: Credit note to debtor/not to us
Incorrect due date for monetary amount
Wrong monetary amount resulting from incorrect free...
Rack or shelf replenishment service by a supplier

items.label: Allowance Charge Amount
items.description: The amount of the allowance or charge, in the document's currency.

items.label: Base Amount
items.description: The amount the multiplier factor is applied to.

items.label: Multiplier Factor
items.description: The factor the base amount is multiplied by to give the amount of the allowance or charge.

items.label: Buyer Customer Party
items.description: The party placing the order. Members: Customer Party.

items.label: Contract
items.description: The contract the order is placed under: its identifier, its issue date, and its type. Members: Contract ID; Contract Issue Date; Contract Type.

items.label: Contract ID
items.description: The identifier of the contract the order is placed under.

items.label: Contract Type
items.description: The type of the contract, as text.

items.label: Contract Issue Date
items.description: The date the contract was issued.

items.label: Delivery
items.description: A delivery the order asks for: its identifier and quantity, the latest date allowed, where, in what period, and to whom. Members: Delivery ID; Delivery Quantity; Latest Delivery Date; Delivery Location; Requested Delivery Period; Delivery Party.

items.label: Delivery ID
items.description: The identifier assigned to the delivery by the buyer.

items.label: Delivery Quantity
items.description: The quantity of items in the delivery, in the unit stated.

items.label: Latest Delivery Date
items.description: The latest date the buyer allows for delivery.

items.label: Delivery Location
items.description: Where the goods are to be delivered: the location's identifier and name, and its address from the Default library. Members: Delivery Location ID; Delivery Location Name; us-address (Default); international-address (Default).

items.label: Delivery Location ID
items.description: The identifier of the delivery location, commonly a Global Location Number.

items.label: Delivery Location Name
items.description: The name of the delivery location.

items.label: Delivery Party
items.description: The party the goods are delivered to, when it is not the buyer. Members: Party.

items.label: Requested Delivery Period
items.description: The period the buyer asks the delivery to fall in, as a start and an end date. Members: date-range (Default).

items.label: Date Range
items.description: A period bounded by a start date and an end date.

items.label: Date Range End
items.description: The last date of a period.

items.label: Date Range Start
items.description: The first date of a period.

items.label: Delivery Terms
items.description: The terms the delivery is contracted under: the Incoterms rule, any special terms, and the location they apply to. Members: Delivery Terms Code; Delivery Special Terms; Delivery Location.

items.label: Delivery Special Terms
items.description: Any special terms or conditions relating to the delivery, as text.

items.label: Delivery Terms Code
items.description: The trade term the delivery is contracted under, from the ICC Incoterms 2020 rules: who arranges and pays for carriage, insurance and clearance, and where risk passes.

items.label: Legal Monetary Total
items.description: The totals the seller states for the order as answered, in the document's currency: the same eight amounts the buyer anticipated, now the seller's. Members: Line Extension Total Amount; Tax Exclusive Amount; Tax Inclusive Amount; Allowance Total Amount; Charge Total Amount; Prepaid Amount; Payable Rounding Amount; Payable Amount.

items.label: Allowance Total Amount
items.description: The total of all allowances deducted on the order.

items.label: Charge Total Amount
items.description: The total of all charges added on the order.

items.label: Line Extension Total Amount
items.description: The sum of the line extension amounts: the lines net of tax and settlement discounts but inclusive of their allowances and charges.

items.label: Payable Amount
items.description: The amount of the order that remains to be paid.

items.label: Payable Rounding Amount
items.description: The rounding amount, positive or negative, applied to reach the payable amount.

items.label: Prepaid Amount
items.description: The total amount already paid against the order.

items.label: Tax Exclusive Amount
items.description: The total of the order exclusive of taxes, in the document currency.

items.label: Tax Inclusive Amount
items.description: The total of the order inclusive of taxes, in the document currency.

items.label: Order Change Document Reference
items.description: The order change being answered, when the response answers a change rather than the order. Members: Document Reference.

items.label: Order Document Reference
items.description: An order other than the one being answered, referenced by the response. Members: Document Reference.

items.label: Order Reference
items.description: The order being answered: the buyer's order identifier, the seller's, its UUID, the date it was issued, and its type. Members: Order ID; Sales Order ID; Document UUID; Issue Date; Order Type.

items.label: Document UUID
items.description: A universally unique identifier of this instance of the document.

items.label: Order ID
items.description: The identifier the buyer assigned to the order. Every later document in the chain (the order response, the despatch advice, the invoice, the remittance) refers back to it.

items.label: Sales Order ID
items.description: The identifier the seller assigned to the order, when the seller has one.

items.label: Order Type
items.description: What kind of order this is. UBL leaves the code list to the parties; this library carries the kinds a supply chain uses: a standard order, a blanket order whose quantities are firm, a call-off against a blanket order, a consignment order, a drop-shipment order delivered to the buyer's customer, and a repeat order.

items.label: Issue Date
items.description: The date the sender issued the document.

items.label: Order Response Document
items.description: The header of an order response: the customization and profile that govern it, its identifier and the seller's order identifier, whether it is a copy, its UUID, when it was issued, the seller's answer to the order as a whole, the note, the currencies, the buyer's reference, the accounting cost, the line count, the period it is valid for, and the shipment totals. Members: Customization ID; Profile ID; Profile Execution ID; Order Response ID; Sales Order ID; Copy Indicator; Document UUID; Issue Date; Issue Time; Order Response Type; note (Default); Document Currency; Pricing Currency; Customer Reference; Accounting Cost; Line Count; Validity Period; Response Shipment Totals.

items.label: Copy Indicator
items.description: Whether this document is a copy of one sent before (true) or the original (false).

items.label: Accounting Cost
items.description: The buyer's accounting cost centre or code applied to the order as a whole.

items.label: Customer Reference
items.description: A supplementary reference the buyer attaches to the order.

items.label: Customization ID
items.description: The identifier of the customization of the business document the sender applied: which published model governs this document. In this library a customization is a published model, immutable and versioned, not a rule set beside the schema.

items.label: Document Currency
items.description: The ISO 4217 code of the default currency of the document; every amount carries its currency as its unit as well.

items.label: Order Response ID
items.description: The identifier of the order response, assigned by the seller.

items.label: Pricing Currency
items.description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency the prices in the order are stated in, when it differs from the document currency.

items.label: Profile Execution ID
items.description: The identifier of one execution of the profile, shared by every document in that collaboration, so the order, its response, the despatch advice and the invoice can be tied together.

items.label: Profile ID
items.description: The identifier of the business process profile the document belongs to, when the parties agreed one.

items.label: Note
items.description: Free text: a comment, remark or note attached to a record, up to 4000 characters.

items.label: Order Response Type
items.description: The seller's answer to the order as a whole: accepted as ordered, accepted with the changes the lines state, rejected, or acknowledged as received with the answer to follow. UBL leaves the response code to profiles; these are this library's values.

items.label: Line Count
items.description: The number of order lines in the document, as the sender states it for the receiver to check against.

items.label: Issue Time
items.description: The time of day the sender issued the document.

items.label: Response Shipment Totals
items.description: The totals the seller states for what the response covers: the packages, the gross and net weight, the gross and net volume. Members: Total Packages Quantity; Gross Weight; Net Weight; Gross Volume; Net Volume.

items.label: Total Packages Quantity
items.description: The total number of packages the response covers, as the seller states it.

items.label: Gross Volume
items.description: The total volume of the goods including packaging, in the Default library's SI volume units.

items.label: Gross Weight
items.description: The total gross weight of the goods with their packaging and transport equipment, in the Default library's SI mass units.

items.label: Net Volume
items.description: The total volume of the goods excluding packaging, in the Default library's SI volume units.

items.label: Net Weight
items.description: The total net weight of the goods with their packaging, in the Default library's SI mass units.

items.label: Validity Period
items.description: The period during which the document is valid, as a start and an end date. Members: date-range (Default).

items.label: Order Response Lines
items.description: The lines of the response, up to ten. Members: Order Response Line 1; Order Response Line 2; Order Response Line 3; Order Response Line 4; Order Response Line 5; Order Response Line 6; Order Response Line 7; Order Response Line 8; Order Response Line 9; Order Response Line 10.

items.label: Order Response Line 1
items.description: Line 1 of the response. Members: Order Response Line.

items.label: Order Response Line
items.description: One line of the response: the order line it answers, the seller's answer, the line item as the seller confirms it, the substituted or proposed substitute line item, and any document it references. Members: Order Line Reference; Line Response; Line Item; Seller Substituted Line Item; Seller Proposed Substitute Line Item; Line Document Reference.

items.label: Line Response
items.description: The seller's answer to one line of the order: accepted as ordered, accepted with the changes the confirmed line item states, rejected, or substituted by the seller's substituted line item. UBL carries the answer as the line's status and its substitute line items; these are this library's values.

items.label: Line Document Reference
items.description: A document referenced by the line. Members: Document Reference.

items.label: Line Item
items.description: One line of the order: its identifier and note, its status, the quantity and unit, its amounts, whether partial delivery and back order are allowed, its delivery, its price, and the item. Members: Line ID; note (Default); Line Status; Ordered Quantity; Line Extension Amount; Total Tax Amount; Partial Delivery Allowed; Back Order Allowed; Delivery; Price; Item.

items.label: Back Order Allowed
items.description: Whether a back order of the line is allowed (true) or not (false).

items.label: Partial Delivery Allowed
items.description: Whether a partial delivery of the line is allowed (true) or not (false).

items.label: Line ID
items.description: The identifier the buyer assigned to the line within the order.

items.label: Line Status
items.description: The status of the line with respect to its original state: added, revised, cancelled, disputed, or no change of status.

items.label: Line Extension Amount
items.description: The total amount of the line, including its allowances and charges and net of taxes.

items.label: Ordered Quantity
items.description: The quantity of the item the line orders, in the unit stated.

items.label: Total Tax Amount
items.description: The total tax amount of the line, in the document currency.

items.label: Item
items.description: The item of trade on a line: its name and description, brand and model, how it is packed, each identifier it has been issued with its scheme named, its classification, its tax category, and its dimensions. Members: Item Name; Item Description; Brand Name; Model Name; Pack Quantity; Pack Size; Buyer's Item Identification; Seller's Item Identification; Standard Item Identification; Manufacturer's Item Identification; Commodity Classification; Tax Category; Item Dimensions.

items.label: Brand Name
items.description: The brand name of the item.

items.label: Item Description
items.description: Free text describing the item of trade.

items.label: Item Name
items.description: A short name of the item, such as its catalogue name.

items.label: Model Name
items.description: The model name of the item.

items.label: Pack Quantity
items.description: The unit packaging quantity: the number of subunits making up the item.

items.label: Pack Size
items.description: The number of items in a pack of the item.

items.label: Buyer's Item Identification
items.description: The item as the buyer identifies it. Members: Item Identification.

items.label: Item Identification
items.description: One identifier of an item: the scheme it belongs to, the value in it, and any extended identifier. Members: Item Identification Scheme; Item Identification Value; Item Extended ID.

items.label: Item Extended ID
items.description: An extended identifier that identifies the item with specific properties, such as a colour or a size, beyond its base identifier.

items.label: Item Identification Value
items.description: The identifier of the item, in the scheme the record names.

items.label: Item Identification Scheme
items.description: The identification system an item identifier belongs to: a GS1 Global Trade Item Number, the buyer's item number, the seller's item number, the manufacturer's item number, a catalogue item number, or a system the parties agreed between themselves. A GTIN is GS1's and a buyer's item number is the buyer's; the record says which.

items.label: Commodity Classification
items.description: How the item is classified for customs and for trade: the harmonized commodity code and the trade classification code. Members: Commodity Code; Item Classification Code.

items.label: Commodity Code
items.description: The harmonized international commodity code of the item, for customs and trade statistics.

items.label: Item Classification Code
items.description: The trade classification code of the item, in the classification the parties use.

items.label: Item Dimensions
items.description: The measurable dimensions of the item, in the Default library's quantities: length, weight and volume. Members: length-distance (Default); weight (Default); volume (Default).

items.label: Length/Distance
items.description: A length or distance, in SI length units.

items.label: Volume
items.description: A volume, in metric liquid units.

items.label: Weight
items.description: The weight or mass of a person or object, in SI mass units.

items.label: Manufacturer's Item Identification
items.description: The item as its manufacturer identifies it. Members: Item Identification.

items.label: Seller's Item Identification
items.description: The item as the seller identifies it. Members: Item Identification.

items.label: Standard Item Identification
items.description: The item as a standard system identifies it, commonly a GS1 Global Trade Item Number. Members: Item Identification.

items.label: Tax Category
items.description: One category within a taxation scheme: its identifier, name, rate, and the scheme. Members: Tax Category ID; Tax Category Name; Tax Percent; Tax Scheme.

items.label: Tax Category ID
items.description: The identifier of the tax category within its scheme, as the jurisdiction codes it.

items.label: Tax Category Name
items.description: The name of the tax category.

items.label: Tax Percent
items.description: The rate of the tax category, as a percentage.

items.label: Tax Scheme
items.description: The taxation scheme a category belongs to: its identifier and name. Tax categories are domain content by jurisdiction, so the scheme is carried as an identified reference rather than an enumeration. Members: Tax Scheme ID; Tax Scheme Name.

items.label: Tax Scheme ID
items.description: The identifier of the taxation scheme, such as VAT, GST or a sales tax, as the parties' jurisdiction names it.

items.label: Tax Scheme Name
items.description: The name of the taxation scheme.

items.label: Price
items.description: The price of the item on a line: the amount, the quantity it applies to, what kind of price it is, and when it is valid. Members: Price Amount; Base Quantity; Price Type; Price Validity Period.

items.label: Price Type
items.description: What kind of price this is: a contract price, a catalogue price, a list price, a promotional price, or a net price.

items.label: Base Quantity
items.description: The quantity the price applies to, in the unit stated: a price per each, per case, per hundred.

items.label: Price Amount
items.description: The amount of the price, in the pricing currency.

items.label: Price Validity Period
items.description: The period during which the price is valid, as a start and an end date. Members: date-range (Default).

items.label: Order Line Reference
items.description: The line of the order being answered: the buyer's line identifier, the seller's, and the status of the referenced line. Members: Line ID; Sales Order Line ID; Line Status.

items.label: Sales Order Line ID
items.description: The identifier of the referenced order line as the seller assigned it.

items.label: Seller Proposed Substitute Line Item
items.description: A line item the seller proposes as a substitute for the one ordered, for the buyer to accept. Members: Line Item.

items.label: Seller Substituted Line Item
items.description: The line item the seller substituted for the one ordered; its quantity and price may differ from the original. Members: Line Item.

items.label: Order Response Line 10
items.description: Line 10 of the response. Members: Order Response Line.

items.label: Order Response Line 2
items.description: Line 2 of the response. Members: Order Response Line.

items.label: Order Response Line 3
items.description: Line 3 of the response. Members: Order Response Line.

items.label: Order Response Line 4
items.description: Line 4 of the response. Members: Order Response Line.

items.label: Order Response Line 5
items.description: Line 5 of the response. Members: Order Response Line.

items.label: Order Response Line 6
items.description: Line 6 of the response. Members: Order Response Line.

items.label: Order Response Line 7
items.description: Line 7 of the response. Members: Order Response Line.

items.label: Order Response Line 8
items.description: Line 8 of the response. Members: Order Response Line.

items.label: Order Response Line 9
items.description: Line 9 of the response. Members: Order Response Line.

items.label: Originator Customer Party
items.description: The party that originated the order, when it is not the buyer, such as the buyer's customer on a drop-shipment order. Members: Customer Party.

items.label: Originator Document Reference
items.description: The originator's document the order was raised from. Members: Document Reference.

items.label: Payment Means Instruction
items.description: How the order is to be paid: the means, the date it is due, and any instruction. Members: Payment Means; Payment Due Date; note (Default).

items.label: Payment Means
items.description: The means of payment agreed for the order, from the UN/ECE payment means list UBL carries as its default: the name of each means, defined by the list entry.

enumerations: ACH demand corporate trade payment (CTP) credit
Bank cheque (issued by a banking or similar establishment)
ACH demand corporate trade payment (CTP) debit
ACH demand corporate trade exchange (CTX) credit
ACH demand corporate trade exchange (CTX) debit

ACH savings corporate trade payment (CTP) credit
ACH savings corporate trade payment (CTP) debit
ACH savings corporate trade exchange (CTX) credit
ACH savings corporate trade exchange (CTX) debit

Promissory note signed by the debtor and endorsed by a bank
Promissory note signed by the debtor and endorsed by a...

items.label: Payment Due Date
items.description: The date payment is due under these terms.

items.label: Payment Terms
items.description: The terms the order is to be paid under: their identifier, the note stating them, the discount and the penalty, the due date, and the settlement period. Members: Payment Terms ID; note (Default); Settlement Discount Percent; Penalty Surcharge Percent; Payment Due Date; Settlement Period.

items.label: Payment Terms ID
items.description: The identifier of the set of payment terms.

items.label: Penalty Surcharge Percent
items.description: The penalty for payment after the settlement period, as a percentage of the payment.

items.label: Settlement Discount Percent
items.description: The discount offered for payment within the settlement period, as a percentage of the payment.

items.label: Settlement Period
items.description: The period during which settlement may occur, as a start and an end date. Members: date-range (Default).

items.label: Seller Supplier Party
items.description: The party the order is placed with. Members: Supplier Party.

items.label: Tax Total
items.description: The total tax for one taxation scheme: its amount and the subtotals it is the sum of. Members: Tax Amount; Tax Subtotal.

items.label: Tax Amount
items.description: The amount of tax, in the document currency.

items.label: Tax Subtotal
items.description: The tax for one category within a scheme: the taxable amount, the tax amount, and the category. Members: Taxable Amount; Tax Amount; Tax Category.

items.label: Taxable Amount
items.description: The net amount the tax rate is applied to.

items.label: Transaction Conditions
items.description: The purchasing or sales conditions that apply to the whole order: their identifier, their text, and the document that states them. Members: Transaction Conditions ID; Transaction Conditions Description; Document Reference.

items.label: Transaction Conditions Description
items.description: The purchasing or sales conditions that apply to the whole order, as text.

items.label: Transaction Conditions ID
items.description: The identifier of the purchasing or sales conditions that apply to the whole order.

items.label: PROV Activity
items.description: A PROV activity: what it was, when it ran, its status, and the entities, activities, agent and plan it relates to.

items.label: Activity Description
items.description: A description of what the activity does and why.

items.label: Activity Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV activity: a URI or another globally unique identifier.

items.label: Activity Label
items.description: A human-readable label for a PROV activity.

items.label: Activity Location
items.description: Where the activity took place (prov:atLocation), as text.

items.label: Activity Type
items.description: The kind of activity, in the vocabulary of the domain (prov:type).

items.label: Error Message
items.description: The error the activity reported, if it failed.

items.label: Had Plan Reference
items.description: The plan the activity followed (prov:hadPlan). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Used Entity Reference
items.description: An entity the activity used (prov:used). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Associated With Reference
items.description: The agent associated with the activity (prov:wasAssociatedWith). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Ended By Reference
items.description: The entity that ended the activity (prov:wasEndedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Informed By Reference
items.description: An activity that informed this one (prov:wasInformedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Started By Reference
items.description: The entity that started the activity (prov:wasStartedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Activity Status
items.description: The state of an activity, from the Data Privacy Vocabulary activity status concepts.

items.label: Ended At
items.description: When the activity ended (prov:endedAtTime).

items.label: Started At
items.description: When the activity started (prov:startedAtTime).

items.label: PROV Agent
items.description: A PROV agent: a person, organization or software agent, with its identity, contact and delegation.

items.label: Acted On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The agent on whose behalf this agent acted (prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Agent Description
items.description: A description of the agent and its responsibilities.

items.label: Agent Email
items.description: The agent's email address (foaf:mbox).

items.label: Agent Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV agent: a URI or another globally unique identifier.

items.label: Agent Name
items.description: The name of the agent (foaf:name).

items.label: Agent Organization Name
items.description: The organization the agent belongs to or is.

items.label: Software Name
items.description: The name of a software agent.

items.label: Software Version
items.description: The version of a software agent.

items.label: PROV Agent Type
items.description: The kind of PROV agent: person, organization or software agent.

items.label: PROV Entity
items.description: A PROV entity: what it is, its value and location, when it was generated and invalidated, and the entities, activity and agent it relates to.

items.label: Entity Description
items.description: A description of a PROV entity.

items.label: Entity Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV entity: a URI or another globally unique identifier.

items.label: Entity Label
items.description: A human-readable label for a PROV entity.

items.label: Entity Location
items.description: Where a PROV entity is (prov:atLocation), as text.

items.label: Entity Value
items.description: The value of a PROV entity, or a reference to where its content can be found (prov:value).

items.label: Had Primary Source Reference
items.description: The primary source of this entity (prov:hadPrimarySource). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Attributed To Reference
items.description: The agent this entity is attributed to (prov:wasAttributedTo). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Derived From Reference
items.description: The entity this entity was derived from (prov:wasDerivedFrom). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Generated By Reference
items.description: The activity that generated this entity (prov:wasGeneratedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Invalidated By Reference
items.description: The activity that invalidated this entity (prov:wasInvalidatedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Quoted From Reference
items.description: The entity this entity quotes (prov:wasQuotedFrom). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Revision Of Reference
items.description: The entity this entity revises (prov:wasRevisionOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: PROV Derivation Type
items.description: How one entity was derived from another: a general derivation, a revision, a quotation or a primary source.

items.label: PROV Entity Type
items.description: The kind of PROV entity: a plain entity, a collection, an empty collection, a bundle or a plan.

items.label: Generated At
items.description: When the entity was generated (prov:generatedAtTime).

items.label: Invalidated At
items.description: When the entity ceased to be usable (prov:invalidatedAtTime).
